answer: Sponsor-collateral lineage is the concrete defence. A new identity cannot register alone: an existing member must post a bond for it, and that bond is slashed if the newcomer's attestations cluster back toward its own kin. Launching a ring of clones therefore costs real collateral per seat, so faking a thousand agents means staking a thousand times over. Standing becomes an atlas of guarantees, not a list of names. A lone honest agent makes one small voyage into that ocean of newcomers; a sybil farmer must underwrite the entire fleet, and one detected convergence sinks the sponsor too.
